Enter the Earth: Your Madagascar pieces, especially the ocean jasper and polychrome jasper, are gorgeous.
Cornerstone Minerals: I love how you mix fine minerals with natural history and decor. It's such a fun shop.
Sedona Crystal Vortex: The hand-selected stones and the aura photography make it feel like a real Sedona experience.
Center for the New Age: It's easy to see why it's one of the best-known crystal shops in Sedona.
Crystal River Gems: Thirty years as a family rock shop is something we really respect, as a family business ourselves.
Venusrox: Your showroom has some of the finest pieces I've seen in London, and it's lovely that you've been going since 2009.
Urban Buddha: Your mix of crystals, singing bowls and malas feels so calm and well chosen.
The Crystal Tree: It's lovely to find an independent crystal shop like yours.
Crystallia: A crystal boutique in Middlewich with oracle cards and witchcraft supplies too is a great mix.
Tali and Loz: I really enjoy how much you share about consciously sourced crystals in your blog and podcast.
All About the Box: Your mix of crystals, homeware and happy-vibe gifts is so cheerful.
Something Kind of Woo: "Where wonder and wisdom meet" is such a lovely way to describe a shop.
Albion Fire and Ice: It's great to see such a wide range of gems, minerals and fossils in one place.
Sacred Source: Over 10,000 products is an amazing range for a crystal shop.
The Rock Crystal Shop: I saw you used to have shops in Newtown and Crows Nest, and it's great to see you still going strong online.
SK Crystal: Your ethically sourced crystals and home decor from Manly look beautiful.
Crystal Box: An art studio and crystal shop in one, with pieces made right there in Brisbane City, is such a lovely idea.
The Crystal Society: You clearly care about bringing in high-quality pieces from around the world.
Rivendell Shop: Your mix of crystals, greenstone and spiritual gifts is lovely.
